title: Branch Conflict State
description: Read-only branch conflict and synchronization state evidence for a PR head.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version of the branch-state evidence document.

prNumber.description: Pull request number whose head and base are classified.

prHeadSha.description: PR head commit SHA, or empty when the published head is unavailable.

prBaseSha.description: PR base commit SHA, or empty when the published base is unavailable.

published.description: Whether the published PR supplied a head SHA for classification.

mergeable.description: GitHub mergeability value used as an input to branch classification, or null when unavailable.

mergeStateStatus.description: GitHub merge-state status used as an input to branch classification, or null when unavailable.

branchState.description: Normalized classification of the PR branch relative to its base and local probes.

syncRecommendation.description: Recommended synchronization action derived from the branch-state classification.

baseAdvancedSinceMergeBase.description: Whether the base advanced beyond the computed merge base; false can also mean the merge base was unavailable or the probe was skipped, so consult diagnostics.notes.

readOnly.description: Whether collection was read-only; this helper reports evidence without mutating GitHub or the worktree.

worktreeUnchanged.description: Whether the local worktree was left unchanged by evidence collection.

diagnostics.description: Supplemental sources, conflict paths, and notes supporting the normalized classification.

mergeableSource.description: Source used for the mergeability value in the classification.

conflictFiles.description: Paths reported by the read-only conflict probe, when one was performed.

notes.description: Additional diagnostic notes explaining classification limits or observations.
